issue_context.title: RainMachine: Repeating errors in log after upgrading to 2022.9.2
issue_context.body:
### The problem

After updating to 2022.9.2 I am now getting repeating log errors from the Rain Machine integration in my log about every 20 seconds. See the log section below for details. 

Entities go unavailable after a short time.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.9.2

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

2022.8.7

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Core

### Integration causing the issue

Rainmachine

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/rainmachine/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
The following repeats continuously:

2022-09-13 14:26:09.390 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant] Error doing job: Task exception was never retrieved
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/homeassistant/helpers/update_coordinator.py", line 151, in _handle_refresh_interval
    await self._async_refresh(log_failures=True, scheduled=True)
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/homeassistant/helpers/update_coordinator.py", line 283, in _async_refresh
    self.async_update_listeners()
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/homeassistant/helpers/update_coordinator.py", line 110, in async_update_listeners
    update_callback()
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/homeassistant/components/rainmachine/__init__.py", line 484, in _handle_coordinator_update
    self.update_from_latest_data()
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/homeassistant/components/rainmachine/update.py", line 102, in update_from_latest_data
    self._attr_latest_version = data["packageDetails"]["newVersion"]
TypeError: list indices must be integers or slices, not str
2022-09-13 14:26:24.065 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant] Error doing job: Task exception was never retrieved
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/homeassistant/helpers/update_coordinator.py", line 151, in _handle_refresh_interval
    await self._async_refresh(log_failures=True, scheduled=True)
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/homeassistant/helpers/update_coordinator.py", line 283, in _async_refresh
    self.async_update_listeners()
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/homeassistant/helpers/update_coordinator.py", line 110, in async_update_listeners
    update_callback()
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/homeassistant/components/rainmachine/__init__.py", line 484, in _handle_coordinator_update
    self.update_from_latest_data()
  File "/srv/homeassistant/lib/python3.9/site-packages/homeassistant/components/rainmachine/update.py", line 102, in update_from_latest_data
    self._attr_latest_version = data["packageDetails"]["newVersion"]
TypeError: list indices must be integers or slices, not str
```


### Additional information

_No response_
